ref: IMG_4442 contact-sheet f007 (globe + 'AT&', oblique; squared up), f008 (square-on 'AT&T', globe cut off: letter widths)
notes: The current AT&T mark: blue striped globe (the stripes read as dark gaps cut into its left side; traced, three visible) then 'AT&T' in white heavy geometric sans, both lit faces, on the black metal fascia band over a wide open storefront with grey slate-tile pilasters. Returns look black (they vanish into the band). Letters set in Inter Bold at 0.9 width to match the square-on f008 tile (AT&T is 3.3x its cap height there). The squared reference leans slightly (letters rise to the right); the 'T' is off its right edge. Cap height ~0.5 m from the ~1.2 m band; globe ~0.75 m.
